title: The opportunity log

D0.outcome: Explains an opportunity log: for each concept, how often it was available in the learner's games and how often it was used.

D1.outcome: From a game with detector-tagged opportunities, states for two concepts how often each was available and used.

D2.outcome: Keeps the log across ten games and reports each concept with its sample size (for example, 'forks: three available, two taken; small sample').

D3.outcome: Compares the log with unlabeled test performance and says whether a gap points to recognition or to execution.

misconceptions: A rate from three chances shows a trait.
sources: 03-product-design.md (opportunities by concept, 'worth checking, not you are bad at pins')
conditions: Small samples are stated as 'worth checking' only.
contrasts: Counting an opportunity only because the engine showed it afterwards (hindsight tag).
A high rate from very few chances treated as skill.
A concept that never came up in the games.
